params.description: The parameters the steps use as {{params.<name>}}, by name.

default.description: The value when an include gives none. Without a default the parameter is required.

record.description: false runs the step off camera: before the recording starts, in the same browser storage (cookies, localStorage). Only the opening steps of a scenario may be off camera; the video starts on the first recorded step.

hold.description: Milliseconds to keep the page on screen after the step, recorded and never trimmed as idle. Use it, not wait, to show a result. Overrides pacing.stepDwellMs; 0 turns the dwell off. Not on an off-camera step.

fragment.description: The fragment file below fragmentsDir (demoflow.config.json; default demoflow/fragments), without .json: "sign-in" reads demoflow/fragments/sign-in.json.

with.description: Values for the fragment parameters, by name; a parameter without a default must be given.

record.description: false runs every step of the fragment off camera, for setup such as signing in. Only the opening steps of a scenario may be off camera.

oneOf.description: Runs the steps of a reusable fragment file here, with its parameters filled in from `with`.

title: DemoFlow fragment
description: Reusable steps a scenario runs with an include step, such as signing in.
